mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_execution WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')) AS active_jobs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_validation_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')) AS active_validations, COALESCE((SELECT used_bytes FROM storage_budget WHERE scope_id=0),0) AS evidence_bytes

SELECT used_bytes,reserved_bytes,limit_bytes,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(data_length+index_length),0) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE()) AS database_allocated_bytes FROM storage_budget WHERE scope_id=0
